basis: Benchmark and Experimental Specification v1.0; new settings below are explicit pilot decisions, not recovered historical practice.
user_owned_pending: approved ordered categorical schema and input dimension

preprocessing.hour_feature: fractional hour including minute, second and fractional second
preprocessing.relative_time: log1p(nonnegative elapsed seconds in UTC); first previous-gap=0
preprocessing.scaler_fit: all original routine training events only; identical in both distributions and A/B/C
preprocessing.summary_transfer: training count, mean and M2 combined; plaintext summaries outside SecAgg protection claim
preprocessing.unknown_missing_loss_policy: map inputs according to approved schema; exclude unknown/missing or training-unseen categorical targets from CE; renormalise categorical mean over valid fields; if none, average binary and temporal groups only; report coverage

model.decoder_initial_h_c: separate linear projections without extra activation
model.loss: mean of mean categorical CE, binary BCEWithLogits and temporal SmoothL1; then mean across valid events/session; mean across sessions/batch
model.initialisation: PyTorch module defaults, explicit stable construction order; LSTM U(-1/sqrt(64),1/sqrt(64)); Linear U(-1/sqrt(fan_in),1/sqrt(fan_in)); no custom forget-gate bias

training.initial_state: one checkpoint per seed reused A/B/C
training.initialisation_algorithm: module defaults in fixed constructor order; save one state per seed/schema; reuse A/B/C
training.optimizer_state_between_rounds: reset before each client fit in B/C; reset before each pooled outer epoch in A; retain within each epoch
training.tensor_order: ordered state_dict keys, checked on every client
training.client_num_examples: number of scheduled complete sessions consumed in this local epoch, including replacement draws; never event count

pilot.sample_selection: sort sessions by SHA256(seed|purpose|client|session_id), take first N; labels never rank selection
pilot.overfit_failure: inspect implementation, not optimise threat performance; no automatic parameter sweep
pilot.fault_tests: public numeric fixtures only, not a new attack study
pilot.subset_model_outputs: engineering artefacts only; never main result checkpoints

sampling.reference: seeded permutation, no replacement, N_k draws
sampling.noniid: N_k draws with replacement; dominant group mass 0.60; remainder 0.40
sampling.mapping_status: new controlled experimental choice, not a claim of medically validated hospital profiles
sampling.session_department: modal recorded event department; lexical tie break
sampling.within_group: uniform across sessions; residual department probabilities follow local session counts
sampling.seed_derivation: first 8 SHA256 bytes, little-endian, modulo 2**32 of seed|condition|client|outer_epoch
sampling.centralised_pool: union of the exact client draws, then deterministic global batch order
sampling.JSD: mean pairwise Jensen-Shannon divergence, log base 2, not square-root distance
sampling.observed_acceptance: both criteria on five-round pooled draw distributions; each dominant mass within 0.05 of 0.60
sampling.failure: stop and document, not search mappings for better test scores

secagg.api_family: legacy flwr.server.strategy + LegacyContext + workflow; do not mix new serverapp strategy API
secagg.max_weight_rationale: exceeds maximum full-training session weight 3676; Q/4096 is integral
secagg.payload: full post-local-training model parameters from FitRes, not gradient tensors or an undocumented delta substitution
secagg.saturation_rule: zero coordinates outside clipping range on the actual weighted pre-quantisation vectors; warning above 80% of range
secagg.numeric_oracles: ordinary float64 FedAvg; separately same weighted/quantised integer sum; actual protocol replay still required
secagg.quantisation_bound: K*2*C/(Q-1)/(sum(n_k)/max_weight) + 2e-6 + 1e-5*max(abs(float_reference)); assumes zero saturation and exact ratio quantisation
secagg.randomness: fresh OS-backed protocol secrets and masks; never fix cryptographic seeds
secagg.strict_round_completion: wrapper must abort before cohort shrinks at any stage and confirm a fresh aggregate; no stale model after workflow early return
secagg.claims: direct individual-update observation only; honest-but-curious server, trusted endpoints, no client-server collusion; isolated network, no TLS/DP/poisoning/final-model privacy claim
secagg.modulus_rationale: power of two below 2**32; 3*Q < M; int64 arithmetic required; verify against pinned runtime

calibration.fit_partition: routine validation only; full validation for final calibration
calibration.degenerate_policy: record flag; report raw scores as well; do not claim nominal FPR guarantee
calibration.checkpoint: minimum session-count-weighted routine validation loss; earliest epoch/round if difference <=1e-12
calibration.score_output: raw and calibrated scores retained; same validation recipe A/B/C; no fit on tests

measurement.topology: one SuperLink, three SuperNodes; same Deployment Runtime for B/C
measurement.host_policy: same dedicated host allocation; proposed CPU-only Linux; >=4 logical CPUs and 16 GiB RAM recommended; actual host unconfirmed
measurement.per_training_process: 1 thread; same affinity/cgroup limits B/C; 3 clients concurrent
measurement.clock_comparison: server wall time for round latency; do not sum overlapping client times
measurement.communication: count outgoing plus incoming at client boundary only across 3 clients; do not also add server totals; report application payload separately from network bytes
measurement.memory: process-tree RSS sampled every 0.05 s; approximate sampled peak, not exact hardware high-water mark
measurement.inference: batch size 1, eval mode, no_grad; 20 warmup plus 200 timed validation sessions, then throughput batch 64; final device explicitly recorded
measurement.overhead_threshold: none invented; resource failures are engineering stops, measured overhead is an outcome, not a reason to delete a run

fail_closed: individual arrays leaked in protected server logs
failures.retry: one complete matched B/C pair retry only for documented transient infrastructure failure; preserve both attempts
failures.bug_change: new code/config version, rerun affected pilot cells; no selective seed replacement

environment_target.status: candidate pins; complete dependency resolution and Flower execution not verified in current runtime; actual experiment-host lock required

inherited_main_evaluation.uncertainty: paired seed comparisons; clustered resampling to be specified
inherited_main_evaluation.localisation: secondary only; after main session evaluation

remaining_freeze_blocks: actual Flower/SecAgg protocol and deployment pilot
final clustered statistical protocol and prior test-exposure disclosure
